research.scope: Finite byte-capacity native-oracle search; exact point-marking adaptation versus simple conventional clause control. No trained RL, literal fixed universal Wang proof tableau, cold corona learner, full Peano arithmetic, full Hilbert geometry or competitive ATP superiority.

qualification_summary.compact_description: Two finite machines produced 9- and 15-type palettes. All 32 state/head/tape contexts matched the independent configuration reference at every layer through two steps. All enumerated row extensions also passed exact marking agreement with the head layer enabled. These literal rows were not solved by the point engine.

compact_example.caption: Fifteen tile types for the nondeterministic control

assessment: Seven point-lane certificates were constructed and independently verified. The two raw searches each leave only one unknown rule byte; the other five accept the generic symbolic proposer’s first complete certificate. This supports integration and checked proof construction, without showing that GCTS found those five proof structures. Six conventional successes have the same proofs and cut sequences. Geometry’s conventional lane stops before the oracle at its 20-million-unit cap; the point solve uses 31,786,013 units under a 50-million-unit cap, with different accounting. Neither the 7-versus-6 coverage nor these single ordered times establish an advantage. No trained RL participates.
evidence_summary: One owned run, 52.038 seconds through worker readback, 158,187,520 bytes observed fresh-child lifetime peak. All 562 complete artifacts (10,749,480 decoded raw bytes), all 451 qualification records and full process logs were reviewed. The archive preserves source versions, rejected controls, unknowns and proof certificates. Instruction traces retain declared prefixes plus full event hashes.

notes: Single ordered run; simple conventional control; unequal operation caps and noncomparable accounting. No practical or causal speed claim.
Inventory instance is checked afresh; complete proofs are expanded to bytes. Closure parent-ID metadata is not a complete dependency graph.
